categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Genrix Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is an innovation-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development, production, and commercialization of antibody drugs. Its primary therapeutic areas include autoimmune diseases, infectious diseases, and oncology. The company develops monoclonal antibodies and bispecific antibodies, with a full industry chain capability from molecular discovery to commercialization.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has established advanced technology platforms including a novel phage display system for monoclonal antibody discovery and bispecific antibody discovery platforms. It also develops single-domain antibodies, new recombinant protein structures, and intracellular antigen antibody technologies. The production platform includes a recombinant antibody process development system covering cell line screening, cell culture, protein purification, and formulation development. The antibody industrialization base complies with Chinese GMP, US cGMP, and European GMP standards, with a current fermentation capacity of 24,400L and plans to expand by an additional 40,000L.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves clinical institutions and patients in China, focusing on autoimmune diseases, infectious diseases, and oncology patients. Its products target unmet clinical needs in these therapeutic areas. The commercialized product, Seliqi monoclonal antibody injection (Jinlixi®), is marketed for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis, benefiting thousands of patients nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in mainland China, with nationwide coverage through a commercial team and strategic partnerships with leading domestic distributors. The production facilities and R&D centers are located in Chongqing, Shanghai, and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chongqing Genrix operates across the entire biopharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream molecular discovery, midstream process development and manufacturing, and downstream clinical research and commercialization. It has integrated capabilities from antibody discovery to large-scale production and market delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development with a focus on clinical demand and unmet patient needs. It continuously invests heavily in R&D, maintaining advanced antibody discovery platforms and expanding its product pipeline. Strategic R&D directions include optimizing phage display technologies, developing bispecific antibodies with low immunogenicity, and expanding indications for existing products. The company also emphasizes building a robust commercial team and expanding production capacity to accelerate commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sales of proprietary antibody drugs, with the first commercialized product being Seliqi monoclonal antibody injection. The company also generates income from technology services and collaborations. Sales are conducted mainly via a distributor model supported by an in-house marketing and medical affairs team.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the innovative biopharmaceutical sector in China, particularly in monoclonal and bispecific antibody drugs. It holds a leading position domestically with the first approved fully human anti-IL-17A monoclonal antibody for psoriasis, breaking the monopoly of imported drugs. Its pipeline includes several products at advanced clinical stages, positioning it among the forefront of domestic innovative antibody drug developers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 30 million, marking its entry into the commercialization phase. It remains unprofitable due to high R&D and commercialization expenses, with a net loss of about RMB 797 million in 2024. The company maintains strong cash reserves and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with cumulative R&D expenses exceeding RMB 1.68 billion over three years. The business is in a rapid growth and development phase with expanding production capacity and commercial infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary technology platforms enabling rapid discovery and development of differentiated antibody drugs with high specificity and low immunogenicity. Its first commercial product is the first domestically approved fully human anti-IL-17A monoclonal antibody, offering a competitive alternative to imported drugs. The integrated full industry chain capability from discovery to commercialization, combined with a strong clinical focus on unmet patient needs, provides unique value and competitive differentiation.
